statement: WITH t AS (SELECT date(ts) d, prediction p FROM workspace.mlpab768409.prediction_log), s AS (SELECT DISTINCT d AS dd FROM t WHERE d > (SELECT min(d) FROM t)) SELECT dd AS split_day, count(CASE WHEN d < dd THEN 1 END) AS n_before, count(CASE WHEN d >= dd THEN 1 END) AS n_after, round(avg(CASE WHEN d < dd THEN p END),4) AS mean_before, round(avg(CASE WHEN d >= dd THEN p END),4) AS mean_after, round( (count(CASE WHEN d < dd THEN 1 END) * count(CASE WHEN d >= dd THEN 1 END) * pow(avg(CASE WHEN d < dd THEN p END) - avg(CASE WHEN d >= dd THEN p END),2)) / count(*), 2) AS score FROM t CROSS JOIN s GROUP BY dd ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT 8
